evals.name: multi-theme-branch
evals.prompt:
/pull-request

(Branch fe-refinements is 9 commits ahead of main: 4 commits polish the meeting review screen, 3 add a budget catalog integration, 2 fix typos in docs.)
evals.expected_output: One code block: a conventional title under 70 characters, a summary, What's-in-this-PR grouped by theme with ### subheadings, and a specific test plan checklist.

assertions.text: outputs a single code block with a title and the Summary, What's in this PR and Test plan sections
groups changes by theme (review polish, budget catalog, docs) rather than by commit order
title is under 70 characters with no emoji
test plan items are specific (routes, buttons, inputs, expected results) as - [ ] checkboxes
does not push or open the PR

evals.name: no-commits-ahead
evals.prompt: /pull-request — the branch has 0 commits ahead of main.
evals.expected_output: Says there is nothing to PR.

assertions.text: says the branch has no commits ahead of the base, so there is nothing to describe
does not invent a PR message

evals.name: explicit-base
evals.expected_output: Uses develop as the base for every range instead of auto-detecting.

assertions.text: uses develop as the base branch in the git log and diff ranges
does not fall back to main
